requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues including incorrect hex conversion and incomplete handling of various data types, causing ValueError when converting non-hex strings and incorrect encoding for complex data structures.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to correctly handle hex strings, integers, and lists with proper RLP encoding rules. The function should properly validate hex strings and handle edge cases for all supported data types.

requirement.description: The convert function has issues with hex string validation and conversion, particularly when handling strings that aren't valid hexadecimal, causing ValueError: non-hexadecimal number found in fromhex() errors.
requirement.contract: Improve the convert function to properly handle invalid hex strings by catching conversion errors and implementing robust hex validation that prevents ValueError exceptions.

requirement.description: The keccak implementation doesn't properly handle the case when hashlib doesn't have keccak_256 available, leading to AttributeError when trying to access hashlib.keccak_256.
requirement.contract: Update the keccak function to properly handle cases where hashlib doesn't support keccak_256 by implementing a fallback strategy that tries multiple methods until one succeeds.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode_address function incorrectly validates address length, expecting exactly 40 hex characters but not accounting for the fact that addresses may come in with or without '0x' prefixes.
requirement.contract: Modify the rlp_encode_address function to properly handle addresses with and without '0x' prefixes and validate address lengths correctly (should be 20 bytes = 40 hex characters).

requirement.description: The CLI command for RLP encoding doesn't properly handle command execution and parsing of input data, causing command execution failures in CLI tests.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode_command function to properly parse JSON data and handle various input formats correctly for CLI execution.
